Today's review

Seasons

Your life moves in seasons, and Rooted carries you the way the season requires. You can declare or override your season at any time. Rooted never argues.

The rooted cycle

Everything starts in the dirt: seeds planted, watered, covered properly, nurtured. Then kept watering until growth. Then sunlight and care. Then the seasons turn: leaves fall, leaves grow back, and it is going to be okay no matter what.

In the dirt: foundation work, seeds covered properly.
Watering: steady nurturing until growth shows.
Sunlight: care and attention while it grows.
Seasons turn: leaves fall, leaves grow back.

Right now: Watering: steady growth, keep nurturing.

Rooted stays nurturing and prepared in every season and every cycle.

Recovery Plan

When life runs hot, Rooted does not send motivation. It runs recovery, the way a careful program would: watch the signs, name the cause, fix today, and redesign so it cannot happen again. Every sign, cause, and date on this screen is seeded sample data.

Watching the signs

How today sounds: Seeded The private tier has not run yet.

Name the cause

The read: too much piled up while the calendar ran full, and the queue aged past what one day can carry.

Pick the read that fits better:

Fix today: one thing

Move the two oldest unpaid money items into tonight's decision stack: the phone bill and the card payment.

Redesign so it cannot happen again: one change

Cap open queue items at 7. Anything older than 5 days auto-surfaces to the top with its age shown, so nothing goes quiet again.

Forecasts, honestly re-baselined

Not wishful dates. Honest ones, set from what the signs actually show.

Book publishing queue: Nov 8 goes to Nov 15

Phone bill failed payment: Oct 31 goes to Nov 3

Tracked until clear

Recovering. The signs are being watched until every one is back under the line.

How recovery is honest

Live later: real check-in history, real queue ages, real Load vs. Capacity remembrance, and real calendar pressure. Seeded now: every sign, cause, fix, and forecast on this screen. Recovery never labels what you are going through. It names what happened in plain words and moves one thing.
